content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Os_80021 The function ReleaseSpinlock shall release a spinlock that has been occupied by the same (calling) Task . If the related GetSpinlock call used configured locks ( OsSpinlockLockMethod ) the function shall also perform the undo of the used lock.
